done_when: Task-mode wrapper propagates the true exit code of the inner process. A test proves a command exiting 1 yields TASK RESULT: FAIL.
need: Task-mode (task=inline) wrapper reports 'TASK RESULT: PASS' even when the inner command prints 'EXIT_CODE=1'. Proof: Results #11, #12, #13 in chat MTS-2026-10-30-1228Z show 'TASK RESULT: PASS' but end with 'EXIT_CODE=1'. The wrapper is likely catching the PowerShell exit code (which is 0 for the Write-Output line) instead of the Python process exit code, or failing to fail-on-error when the inner command exits non-zero.
title: AIBridge task-mode swallows exit codes (reports PASS on failure)
